official.deadline_note: SUSS publishes two recurring windows on both the scholarship page and the FAQ: January Semester intake 1 August to 15 September, July Semester intake 1 February to 15 March. As of verification (10 October 2026) the January Semester window closed on 15 September 2026, so the next closing date is 15 March 2027 for the July Semester intake. Outcomes are emailed by end November for the January Semester and by end June for the July Semester.
official.application_cycle: Two intakes per year: January Semester (application window 1 August to 15 September) and July Semester (application window 1 February to 15 March)
official.status_note: Standing institutional award with recurring application windows; on 10 October 2026 the 1 August-15 September window for the January Semester intake has closed, and the next window runs 1 February to 15 March 2027 for the July Semester intake.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The award covers 100% of course fee (inclusive of government subsidy) for the recipient's remaining candidature of study. It includes course materials, examination fee and other compulsory fees, as well as Miscellaneous Fees.

Scholarship recipients may not concurrently hold any other scholarship, fellowship, award or allowance without prior approval from the University

verification.notes: All figures taken from the awarding body's own pages: the Part-time Undergraduate Scholarships & Sponsorships page, the SUSS Scholarship Terms and Conditions PDF (updated 30 Sep 2025) and the Scholarships/Sponsorships FAQ PDF (updated 2nd September 2026). The official pages publish the value only as 100% of course fee (inclusive of government subsidy) plus fee items; no monetary figure, currency or stipend amount is published anywhere, so funding_amount, funding_currency and funding_period remain null. Living costs and travel are not among the published benefits, so living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage are false and fully_funded is false - the catalogue's 'Fully Funded' label is not supported by the official wording, which covers fee-type items only. No IELTS/TOEFL or MOI rule is published for this scholarship.

applicant_utility.summary: This award pays your entire SUSS part-time course fee - including the government-subsidised portion - for the rest of your candidature, and also covers course materials, the examination fee, other compulsory fees and Miscellaneous Fees, with no bond. It is worth most to students who have already been admitted to a part-time programme, because new applicants must secure admission first. You must be a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident, and Law students are shut out entirely. Keep in mind the obligations: a cumulative GPA of at least 3.8, sitting every examination, SUSS LEAD Academy membership and representing the University at events, plus repayment of everything received if you withdraw early.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident working adult with strong academic results and a deep co-curricular and community-service record, already admitted (or about to be admitted) to a SUSS part-time degree outside Law.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure admission to a part-time programme first - new students are only considered once accepted, and the scholarship window is short
Gather your CCA and award records before the window opens; the FAQ names them compulsory softcopy documents for the e-application
Have particulars of family members ready to complete inside the form where required
Check you can sustain a cumulative GPA of 3.8 across your remaining candidature before accepting
Confirm you hold no other scholarship, fellowship, award or allowance that would need University approval to run concurrently
common_rejection_risks: Submitting the scholarship application before admission is confirmed - new students who jump the queue are only assessed after they are accepted
Applying into a Law programme, which is excluded from this award

An unbalanced profile - the published criteria demand outstanding results AND an impressive co-curricular record AND demonstrated leadership and community-service involvement, so strong grades alone are not enough
Applying as an international student on the wrong page - this specific award is SC/PR only, and international students are only considered for selected full-time donor scholarships
Assuming an appeal is possible - the Student Awards Committee's decision is final, binding, unreasoned and cannot be appealed
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Fee-type items only are covered: living and accommodation costs, transport, and personal expenses are entirely out of pocket.
document_audit: CCA and award records are compulsory during the e-application - a missing upload can sink an otherwise stellar application
Particulars of family members are requested where required, so have household details on hand rather than hunting for them mid-form
Successful candidates must sign a separate letter and agreement containing the detailed terms and conditions before any money is disbursed
alerts: Windows are short and fixed: 1 August to 15 September for the January Semester and 1 February to 15 March for the July Semester; the January window closed on 15 September 2026, so the next opportunity is 1 February to 15 March 2027
Previously unsuccessful candidates need not re-apply - SUSS carries them forward, so do not duplicate submissions
Acceptance commits you to a cumulative GPA of 3.8, sitting all examinations, LEAD Academy membership and University event participation; early withdrawal can trigger repayment of all monies received
This specific award pays no stipend despite a 'Fully Funded' catalogue label - budget for the cost of living yourself
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission e-application first, then log in to the SUSS e-application portal (via the Scholarships or Sponsorships page or SUSS Connect) inside the window, upload the compulsory CCA and award records, and wait for the email outcome (end November for the January Semester, end June for the July Semester).
